title: Decision: is_fips flag makes non-FIPS providers invisible at lookup time
description: When any provider with is_fips=1 registers, fips_provider_count is incremented INSIDE the write lock. Subsequent lookups skip providers where is_fips=0. This two-layer enforcement (visibility + per-op gate) is correct. Layer 1 prevents routing to unvalidated paths. Layer 2 checks operational health. The counter update inside the write lock prevents a race where a reader sees the FIPS provider in the list but reads a stale zero counter. A reviewer suggesting 'just rely on per-op gate checks' would leave a window where a non-FIPS provider is reachable. FIPS 140-3 requires segregation of validated and unvalidated implementations.
close_reason: Reviewed, documented, and hardened in CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, and AGENTS.md
